summary: The exact preflighted 19-image MatRIS-primary/AQCat25-audit GPU complete-path request was explicitly authorized and submitted once to MZ73 as Slurm job 1327; its initial scheduler state was PENDING for priority, and no VASP or VTST calculation was submitted.

payload.objective: Monitor MZ73 job 1327 and collect its complete candidate path only after producer terminal evidence exists.
current_evidence: The request, remote preflight, user authorization, execution review, dist.pl output, nebmovie.pl 0 output, and movie hashes all passed immediately before submission.
MZ73 accepted exactly one Slurm job with ID 1327 and job name c2ho-v5-19.
The scheduler reported job 1327 as PENDING with reason Priority and elapsed time 0:00 at the submission checkpoint.
The job uses frozen MatRIS as the path-optimization primary and AQCat25 only as an exact same-structure fixed-path auditor.
The result remains a predicted path candidate only; no VASP, Dimer, frequency, TS, barrier, fine-tuning, or automatic retry action is authorized.
payload.one_executable_step: Check job 1327 scheduler state and producer evidence; collect and review the complete returned path only after a terminal producer record exists.
payload.submission_boundary: This authorization covered one GPU job only. Do not automatically retry, fine-tune, submit VASP/VTST, prepare Dimer, or claim a TS/barrier from its output.
done_when: A producer terminal record for job 1327 exists and the scheduler state is separately reported.
On success, the complete returned path is collected into work and enters geometry, periodic, energy, force, and chemistry review; on failure, only the failure evidence is recorded.
